prompt: Perform a read-only engineering review of the new iOS 27 Spatial SoundCloud proof-of-concept on branch feature/spatial-soundcloud-ios27-poc. Inspect the files under experiments/spatial-soundcloud-ios27/ and cloudflare/spatial-soundcloud-auth/. Focus on likely Xcode 27 / Swift 6 compile errors, incorrect use of the new AVAudioMixInputParametersTrackID.mixID and MTAudioProcessingTapCreateWithPreferredFormat APIs, C callback lifetime/realtime-safety problems, PKCE/OAuth mistakes, Keychain mistakes, SoundCloud API model/URL mistakes, and any audio-DSP correctness bug that would invalidate the proof. Do not modify files. Do not spend time on styling or future features.
context: Apple 2026 HLS docs say whole-mix streaming taps use AVAudioMixInputParametersTrackMixID / Swift AVAudioMixInputParametersTrackID.mixID and recommend MTAudioProcessingTapCreateWithPreferredFormat.
SoundCloud current docs require OAuth 2.1 PKCE but still require client_secret for token exchange/refresh, so the repo uses a Cloudflare Worker broker.
SoundCloud /tracks/{track_urn}/streams remains authenticated; the app preflights the chosen AAC HLS URL with URLSession and expects a final signed CDN redirect before giving it to AVPlayer.
The first DSP intentionally implements simple non-individualized ITD plus frequency-dependent contralateral filtering, with deterministic tests; it is not claiming measured HRTF accuracy.
expected_response: Return only actionable findings, ordered by severity. For each finding give file, problem, why it matters, and a concrete fix. Explicitly state if a suspected issue cannot be confirmed without Xcode 27. Keep under 1600 words.
